lastResponse.text: Yes, you can keep this minimal. You do not need to share anything you’re not comfortable sharing. We can start with just: he’s a veteran in Lane County, recently bereaved, and needs fast housing placement. If you want, I can stay with you while you make the call and use only that. If he becomes in immediate danger, call `9 1 1`.
